Hook rule: Generate 5 declarative hook candidates, then select one 5–10 words long. No why/how/what question, no Did you know, Have you ever wondered, Ever notice, Today we will, or generic setup. The concrete object must appear in the first clause and the contradiction must be understandable within about 1 second.
Story clock: 0–1s show the paradox; 1–3s state the contradiction; 3–7s give a clue without fully answering; 7–14s reveal the mechanism; 14–21s deliver the second reveal or consequence; 21–27s payoff and visually echo the opening. Target 25–29 seconds total, hard max 30 seconds, roughly 65–82 spoken words. No generic outro or subscribe CTA.
Fact boundaries: Do not claim all drops are perfect spheres. Gravity, motion and surface wetting matter, and falling raindrops are not classic teardrop shapes.
Source: https://www.usgs.gov/water-science-school/science/surface-tension-and-water
